subject: Kilowatt Android 1.0.1 comparison against current V9 integration

observed_realtime_markers: No user ID, skipping subscription setup
station_state_markers: Connector not available or station offline.

comparison_to_v9.reason: The app embeds Realtime/status/price logic but its embedded Supabase anon key is rejected by the backend. A legitimate app session would be required to validate richer live data.

pipeline_issue_found.interpretation: The data-lab inventory classifier is older than the V9 Morocco GPS validator. Three non-test records are excluded by the older bounds and should be revalidated before expanding the production inventory from 43 to 46.
pipeline_issue_found.tariff_overlay_dependency: Current tariff manifest covers exactly 43 production stations (26 free, 17 unresolved); expanding inventory requires rebuilding and validating the tariff overlay.

production_decision.next_safe_improvement: Validate the three geo-filtered stations and, if confirmed, rebuild the Kilowatt inventory and tariff overlay for 46 production stations.
